name: Adventurer's Ring
descriptionHtml: While the cover on this ring is open, the ring produces a flame that creates no heat and consumes no fuel. It sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 20 feet. As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can close the cover, smothering the flame, or open it again.

name: Axe Beak
descriptionHtml: Use the Axe Beak stat block.

name: Bright Fungal Cloak
descriptionHtml:
While wearing a Bright Fungal Cloak, you can take a Bonus Action|XPHB to furl or unfurl it. When the cloak is unfurled, it sheds Bright Light|XPHB in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light|XPHB for an additional 5 feet.

One pound of fungus is sewn into a Bright Fungal Cloak. This fungus can be eaten as food. Once all the fungus is consumed, the cloak becomes a mundane set of Traveler's Clothes.

name: Covered Wagon
descriptionHtml: This vehicle is a Wagon covered by durable canvas. A creature has Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover while riding inside this vehicle.

name: Cult of the Dragon Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A dragon claw pendant on a leather cord
2Ashes of a dracolich in a small brass canister
3A map of an unknown dragon's lair
4A black pearl etched with a Draconic rune
5A drop of dragon's blood preserved in amber
6A scrap of purple silk

name: Desert Clothing
descriptionHtml: When you are wearing Desert Clothing and not wearing Medium or Heavy armor, you automatically succeed on saving throws against the effects of extreme heat.

name: Devil Mask
descriptionHtml: While you are wearing a Devil Mask, other creatures have Disadvantage|XPHB on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern your true identity or intentions.

name: Emerald Enclave Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A pair of earrings made from oak leaves that never wilt
2A miniature model cottage made of twigs
3A green-glowing firefly in a bottle
4A gourd that sounds like rustling leaves when held to one's ear
5A preserved rabbit's foot on a leather strap
6An antler shaped like an Elvish rune

name: Flying Snake
descriptionHtml: Pet flying snakes use the Flying Snake stat block.

name: Garb of Light and Shadow
descriptionHtml: This garb appeals to Fey from one Domain of Delight, such as the Gloaming Court or the Summer Court. While wearing the garb, you have Advantage|XPHB on ability checks to influence Fey associated with that Domain of Delight.

name: Genie Robe
descriptionHtml: This robe appeals to Elementals associated with a particular Elemental Plane (Air, Earth, Fire, Water). While wearing a Genie Robe, you have Advantage|XPHB on ability checks made to influence Elementals associated with that plane.

name: Harper Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A broken harmonica
2A powder compact with a hidden compartment
3A 2-foot-long peacock feather
4A trick coin that's heads on both sides
5A pair of red-tinted spectacles
6A scroll of sheet music for an unknown instrument

name: Locking Spellbook
descriptionHtml: This 100-page leather-bound tome can be used as a Spellbook. It is closed with a lock that comes with a key. As a Utilize action, a creature can try to pick the lock using Thieves' Tools, doing so with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

name: Lords' Alliance Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A scrap from a defeated army's banner
2A bit and bridle engraved with the name of a famous steed
3The broken blade of a sword used in a famous battle
4The left glove of a lord who went mysteriously missing
5An articulated toy horse and knight
6A spaulder emblazoned with the insignia of an unidentified lord

name: Monster Camouflage
descriptionHtml: A suit of Monster Camouflage looks like a Beast or Monstrosity, such as an owlbear. To discern that you're disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation or Nature) check. The creature has Advantage|XPHB on this check if it is within 30 feet of you and automatically succeeds on this check if you do anything the monster you're disguised as couldn't do.

name: Order of the Gauntlet Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A white feather as heavy as lead
2An empty vial made from stained glass
3A single cone of gold-flecked incense
4A silken blindfold
5One half of a pair of manacles
6A tarnished aspergillum

name: Purple Dragon Knight Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1An amethyst dragon wyrmling's claw
2A common purple quartz cut to resemble a dragon's eye
3A signal whistle audible only to amethyst dragons
4A robin's egg encased in amber
5A whetstone that leaves any blade it hones faintly glittery
6A vamplate taken from a slain rival jouster

name: Red Wizard Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A gnarled wand made from petrified yew
2A glass jar containing the preserved heart of an unknown animal
3A unicorn figurine carved from obsidian
4A tattoo needle made from one of your own bones
5A bronze amulet in the shape of a scorpion
6A razor made of crimson steel

name: Sled Dog
descriptionHtml: A sled dog uses the Wolf stat block (see the Monster Manual). A sled dog pulling a sled alone must take a Short Rest|XPHB after pulling a sled for 1 hour; otherwise, it gains 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Thayan Spell Tattoo
descriptionHtml:
This magical tattoo contains the essence of a level 1-3 spell chosen by the tattoo's creator. While the tattoo is on your body, you always have the associated spell prepared, and you can cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spell uses your spellcasting ability; otherwise, if the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13 and the attack bonus is +5. If your Attunement|XPHB to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes.

You can also cast the spell once without a spell slot and spell components. Once the spell is cast in this way, the tattoo vanishes.

Inking Thayan Spell Tattoos.

The Thayan art of magical tattooing is highly guarded by its practitioners, and thus, Thayan Spell Tattoos can't be crafted like other magic items. To learn how to ink Thayan Spell Tattoos, you must have a Renown Score of 50+ with the Red Wizards.

To ink a Thayan Spell Tattoo, you must have proficiency in the Arcana skill and with Calligrapher's Supplies and have the spell prepared each day of the inking. You must also have at hand any Material components required by the spell; if the spell consumes its Material components, they are consumed when you complete the tattoo. Inking a Thayan Spell Tattoo takes the same amount of time and money|XDMG|6|Time and Cost as scribing a Spell Scroll of an equivalent level.

name: Warm Fungal Clothing
descriptionHtml: When you're wearing Warm Fungal Clothing, you automatically succeed on saving throws against the effects of extreme cold. See chapter 3 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for rules on extreme cold. One pound of fungus is sewn into Fungal Clothing. This fungus can be eaten as food. Once all the fungus is consumed, this becomes a mundane set of Traveler's Clothes.

name: Winter Camouflage
descriptionHtml: While you wear Winter Camouflage in an appropriate environment, you have Advantage|XPHB on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: Zhentarim Trinket
descriptionHtml:
1d6Trinket
1A broken dagger etched with your name
2A glass eye that always turns to face you
3A gold-colored serpent's tooth
4A counterfeit gold coin
5A crystal tattoo needle
6A contract on a slip of parchment that's impervious to creases, tears, and fire
